extraction.Name: William Bridgeman
extraction.Occupation/Income: Farming and working at odd jobs.
extraction.NOTES: Just my wife and I depend on him for support; not in good health; it was agreed by the purchaser that he was to get the fence on the east and south side of the land but he did not go for it; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on June 6, 1929
